stones.name: African Blue Sapphire
stones.subtitle: PRECIOUS
stones.description: African blue sapphires are named after their origin in Africa- primarily sourced from mines in Madagascar, Kenya, and Tanzania. The geological conditions in East Africa that make blue sapphire distinctive is due to mineral-rich soils and unique environmental factors. High concentrations of aluminum, iron, and titanium, combined with volcanic activity and metamorphic processes, create sapphires with fewer inclusions and vibrant blue hues, enhanced by slow magma cooling and specific pressure and temperature conditions.  They often exhibit a mesmerizing “silk” effect. This phenomenon takes place due to tiny rutile needle inclusions creating a soft, velvety appearance, enhancing the stone’s beauty. Their unique color clarity, combined with their relative rarity is what makes them highly sought-after in the gem market. These majestic sapphires stand out because of their intense color and fewer inclusions than sapphires from other regions.
